background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, the holding company sits structurally below the operating bank it owns. Leverage of 7.5% is in the top quarter of US banks; the paragraph carries no current CET1 or liquidity figures to set beside it. Flagged news in the last 90 days is supervisory and staffing, an SEC censure without a fine and rounds of layoffs, the newest on 6 Oct 2026, none of it touching credit standing.
